existingDispositions.rationale: Shame-regulation norms are distinct from national cultural tightness and an individual's shame report; country correlations do not identify within-person shame causation.
Anxiety is associated with poorer working-memory task performance and experimentally induced anxiety can impair tasks; task capacity/performance are not the entire available-resource construct.
Keep existing fear→risk preference interpretation with its appraisal/domain qualifications; state-induction studies support direction in particular choices, not universal risk aversion.
Keep existing anger→risk preference interpretation with its qualifications; particular induced-state choices support it, not every risky behavior.
Emotion-regulation capacity is not habitual strategy use or instructed reappraisal. Cited dispositional psychopathology synthesis and ERQ validation do not isolate available capacity→anger.
Punishment-sensitivity trait may influence state anxiety, but BIS/avoidance item overlap and trait-state measurement need independent evidence.
Neuroticism is canonically a tendency toward negative affect/stress sensitivity; correlations with stress can partly share content. Kotov examines diagnoses, not exact current appraisal.
Identity threat, identification, perceived injustice and anger are distinct. Collective-action meta-analyses do not isolate this exact threat→anger proposition.
Intolerance of uncertainty predicts anxiety/worry in literature but trait and anxious-response scales share definitions/items; exact temporal causal leverage remains unresolved.
Perceived stress is appraisal, while BIO-009 is post-stressor recovery rate. RDoC framework citations are not evidence for this exact causal segment.
Cognitive load, task difficulty, distress and resource-exceeding appraisal are distinct. Framework citations do not isolate load→perceived stress.
Moral conviction is not a moral transgression or generic disgust word. Tightness and dehumanization source assignments do not substantiate exact conviction→disgust.
Received emotional support is actual care/reassurance, not perceived support availability. Existing framework citations do not identify its precise effect on appraisal.
Audience presence can change evaluation conditions, but SRC-509 diffusion/review components do not directly support conscious activation in a specified performance.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Fear and anxiety are synonymous.
gapQuestions.rationale: Concrete imminent threat and uncertain future apprehension are distinct even when scales co-load.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cyclic sighing reduces state anxiety more than an attention comparator.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA-0008 retains within-group change and between-group nondetection separately; no causal sign from pre/post alone.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reduced breathing rate proves reduced subjective arousal.
gapQuestions.rationale: Physiology is not consciously reported activation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: PANAS positive affect improvement proves bipolar mood valence improved.
gapQuestions.rationale: Activation-containing score is not exact whole-construct valence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Presenting specified film clips increases discrete sadness relative to neutral clips.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA-0009: differential emotion profiles and broad reviews promising, but exact same-item clip/comparator estimate not extracted; preserve mixed emotions.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A negative-emotion composite proves separate causal effects on all its Driver components.
gapQuestions.rationale: No inference from average to every component, including fear/anger/sadness/stress.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Reconstrual reduces exact experienced fear/anger/sadness in a pandemic context.
gapQuestions.rationale: Large randomized study uses composites; exact discrete outcome, demand and attrition need reconciliation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral disgust amplifies later moral judgment.
gapQuestions.rationale: Publication-bias adjustment and confounds undermine universal sign; exact target PSY construct not selected from generic condemnation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Moral conviction is equivalent to disgust intensity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Belief moralization, transgression appraisal and aversion are distinct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Public-role norm reminders increase shame.
gapQuestions.rationale: Tightness not exact CUL-076 operation, audience and self-evaluation needed; reuse REL-CUL-047 review.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Shame/embarrassment combined ratings isolate shame.
gapQuestions.rationale: Grouped item cannot separate the two states.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Autobiographical specific-action recall increases guilt.
gapQuestions.rationale: Recall may bundle sadness, responsibility and shame; exact comparator and independent action/omission referent required.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Success feedback increases whole pride intensity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Authentic/hubristic facets and feedback attribution not uniform; no full construct claim from one subscale.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Agency/pathways hope equals current hopeful affect.
gapQuestions.rationale: Related cognitive/motivational and affective constructs need boundaries, not synonym edge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Hope-focused therapy increases PSY-048.
gapQuestions.rationale: Agency/pathways scales and multi-session packages not exact current affect; no package efficacy from components.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Compassion practice increases empathic concern.
gapQuestions.rationale: Self-directed versus other-directed target and review/control differences unresolved; no generic meditation identity/effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: More donations or shared neural activity prove greater empathic concern.
gapQuestions.rationale: Behavioral allocation and affect sharing are not caring concern.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Goal blockage increases frustration.
gapQuestions.rationale: Review reward-proximity/effort design; source report invalid force, no EMG difference and opposite RT expectation. Missing exact upstream Driver, not substitute goal conflict.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Faster or stronger responses are frustration itself.
gapQuestions.rationale: Replication separates self-report, motor and EMG; no proxy as semantic entity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cash transfers decrease perceived stress.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cohen4-item finding promising, but exact transfer/time/spillover comparison and canonical appraisal window needed before a formal candidate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Support→perceived stress→physiological recovery is mediated.
gapQuestions.rationale: PRC chain not transmitted-effect evidence; care versus support perception and cortisol versus recovery slope must align.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A cortisol null means perceived-stress null.
gapQuestions.rationale: Different outcomes can diverge; source reports stress reduction and no average cortisol effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Vacant-land greening reduces momentary sadness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cluster RCT supports certain K6 symptom items, not exact transient sadness; bundled cleanup/planting/fencing/maintenance cannot be split.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep loss increases anxiety and reduces affective wellbeing.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reuse HT-V1-INF-F03-007 only if exact overnight operation matches; heterogeneous restriction/fragmentation not same identity; exact state/trait/time needs extraction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Anxiety induction changes enduring intolerance of uncertainty or punishment sensitivity.
gapQuestions.rationale: State response is not demonstrated lasting trait change.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Certainty/control appraisals modify emotion→risk preference.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing REL-PSY-026/027 exact edges identified; manipulation/mediator identification and PSY-013 versus attribution of control require follow-up.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Regulation capacity modifies identity threat→anger.
gapQuestions.rationale: Exact REL-PSY-046 known, but available capacity versus strategy, timing and independent interaction evidence absent.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Audience performance effects prove subjective-arousal mediation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Exact self-reported activation and transmitted path not measured by diffusion citations.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Anxiety and working-memory availability are inversely associated.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing causal edge audit records association support; do not create duplicate until measurement/time/ownership split decided.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Shame precedes guilt in self-evaluation.
gapQuestions.rationale: No universal temporal ordering extracted; different states cannot TRANSITIONS_TO each other merely from theory.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural or disaster occurrence proves every exposed person's emotional consequence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Exposure, appraisal, occurrence and consequence need separate evidence; no universal effect from contextual fact.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stress and anxiety scales duplicate one another.
gapQuestions.rationale: Related tension/negative-affect content requires item/time-specific comparison, not automatic ontology merge.
